• Setup deep-links: the "Open Setup" buttons on each panel jump straight to the matching Setup page (Apex Jobs or Scheduled Jobs) in a new browser tab. Keep this Monitor tab open as your dashboard and use Setup tabs for actions.
  • Schedule helper is idempotent: clicking Schedule Nightly ETL while the cron is already registered does nothing (no toast either way). The button only renders when the cron is actually missing.
  • Sandbox refresh playbook: refreshes wipe all scheduled jobs. After refresh, open Health Monitor → if the nightly ETL alert is showing, click the button. That's the entire post-refresh setup.
  • Error sources: the Recent Errors panel reads from Dashboard_Run__c and Dashboard_Component_Run__c. Apex batch errors live in the Apex Jobs panel (look at ExtendedStatus). For deeper Apex logs, enable trace flags in Setup → Debug Logs.
